Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, to be performed every six months as indicated by M6 
in the above title block.
Item | Technical data | Item | Technical data
Equipment | Circulating water pump | Manuf | Franco tosi - Italy
Pump type | propeller / 5 blades | Model | E 145
Motor operation | electric | Design 
 temperature | Max 35C
Type of 
 fluid | River water | Specific gravity | 1.00
Speed | 330 RPM | Seal 
 type | Packing / 3 rings
Manometric 
 head | 8.1 M | Rotation | Counter - clock wise
Max 
 total head | 23m | Shaft | Vertical
SHR | 9.6 M |  | 
The first draft initiated by eng. Ragab Goada Abo-Zeed tested by eng. Emad 
Abraheem Gooda, accepted by general manager eng. Hassan Saeed Dosoki , approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves ...etc
Shutdown the pump
Circuit breaker of pump 
 racked out
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Grease gun
Cleaning fluid, rags
Work to be carried out
Fill the coupling with grease
Take sample to check the thrust 
 bearing oil chemical and physical
